title: 第十章 准武者考核
content_zh:
“爸妈，我去城中心的‘极限会馆’了，今天中午可能就不会来吃饭了。”罗峰喝了一大碗粥，以及三个面饼后站起来，“你们今天就等着我的好消息吧，我一通过考核，会立即打电话给你们的。”
母亲龚心兰笑着瞥一眼罗洪国：“洪国，听到了么，你可要随身带着手机。别到时候儿子都找不到你。”
“我肯定带着手机。”罗洪国呵呵一笑。
“嗯，我出去了。”
罗峰朝弟弟罗华眨了下眼，弟弟罗华竖起大拇指嘿嘿一笑。
××××××
一大清早，罗峰就离开南岸小区，沿着11号地铁线到了‘中安路站’，而后转1号线，到了扬州城城中心区域，出了地铁站后，又步行了十分钟这才抵达扬州城的极限武馆总部――极限会馆。
从家出来时候才六点多点，等罗峰抵达目的地，已经近上午八点了。
“这就是传说中的明月小区？”罗峰站在一所幽静小区的大门口外，这座小区名叫‘明月小区’，而极限会馆就在这座小区内。
“这位先生，这是明月小区，不要靠近。”
只见小区门口，正站着一排六名穿着军服真枪实弹的军人。看他们军服就能判断……这些人并不是警察系统，而是军队系统的。其中一名军人朝罗峰喝道：“先生，还请退后，一旦你进入黄线区域，我们有权将你直接击毙！”
“和传闻中一样啊。”罗峰心中暗叹。
明月小区，是极限武馆在扬州城的大本营！
这里，不但有极限会馆，同时也是极限武馆麾下武者家庭的居住地。
“传言说，住在这里面的，都是武者和他们的家属！连警察们也没资格擅闯。”罗峰心中惊叹。
“各位。”罗峰站在小区门口，开口道，“我是极限武馆高级学员‘罗峰’，这次过来，是接受准武者考核的。”极限会馆每个月的1号，都会举行准武者考核。
“哦？”
在小区旁边的看守守卫休息室里面走出来一名花白头发的老者，他的手中捧着一掌上电脑，“年轻人，你来的挺早的，八点钟没到就到了。年纪轻轻就进行准武者考核，前途无量啊。嗯，将你的身份证、高级学员证，都给我检查一下。”
罗峰递过身份证和学员证。
“嘟！”

身份证和高级学员证，分别在掌上电脑上划过，掌上电脑屏幕上接连浮现讯息。
“18周岁？”这花白头发老者惊讶看了一眼罗峰，笑盈盈道，“18周岁，就敢来进行准武者考核，不错，希望你今天能够通过。”
“谢谢老先生。”罗峰也说道。
“放他进去吧。”花白头发老者一挥手。
顿时小区的电动拉门自动拉开，同时一名手持着突击步枪的军人上前一步，跟随在罗峰身旁：“先生，我会带你去极限会馆。请先生在进入小区后，不要乱跑！你只有进入极限会馆的权限，不得进入武者家属住宿区。若违反规定，就算我不动手，在小区内巡逻的兄弟也会动手的。”这名军人说着还朝罗峰咧嘴一笑。
“一定。”罗峰微笑点头，心中暗惊……
国家和极限武馆，的确是合作关系。至少在极限武馆的核心区是重点保护的。
“呼，一栋栋，都是独栋别墅。”罗峰一眼看过去，除了小区中央，那高高耸立的一座极限会馆外。其他地方则是错落有致的一栋栋独栋别墅，而且在别墅之间，还有着假山、水池、草地。
××××××
明月小区中心，极限会馆内，当罗峰步入极限会馆大堂的时候，那名军人也就回去了。
“先生，你是接受准武者考核的？”会馆大堂中，一名长相甜美的少女微笑道，“先生，请坐那边。等到上午十点的时候，再和其他人统一进行准武者考核。”
罗峰点点头，朝会馆大堂边上走去，这里是一个小型酒吧，有一名服务生和一名调酒师。
“嗯？”罗峰扫了一眼，这小型酒吧中已经有三个人坐着了。
其中两个人在谈论着，而另外一人在另外一沙发上沉默坐着。
“看，那边的一栋栋别墅，就是加入极限武馆武者的福利了。”一名白衣白裤青年兴奋说道，“只要成为武者，加入极限武馆。就能免费被分配到一栋。而且以后就能住在这了……啧啧，你看这环境，多舒坦。”
“武者小区，当然和外面普通小区不一样。看，来新人了。”这三人也看到了罗峰，罗峰朝这三人微微点头，就坐到了一旁的沙发上。
大家彼此不认识，所以也没有交谈。
随着时间流逝，接连又来了三个人，这三个人罗峰同样不认识，不过看样子……这三人年龄都比较大，估计都超过三十岁，甚至有过四十岁的人。
“哈，罗峰！”一道响亮声音响起。
罗峰吃了一惊，转头看去，只见脸上有着一道狰狞疤痕的精瘦汉子走了过来：“你也过来进行准武者考核了？”

“杨哥？”罗峰连站起来迎过去。
“说起来够丢脸的，上一个月，我来测试过一次。可惜――我测试速度，一秒只是达到24.9米。就差那么一点点啊，没过！”杨武无奈说道，其实在拳力、神经反应速度上，杨武早就过关了，就是速度上是弱项。
不过今年以来，杨武在速度上也逐渐进步，24.9米和25米，其实不算什么差距，临时状态好一点，成绩就可能是25米了。
“相信杨哥你这次一定能过关。”罗峰笑道。
“这姓杨的，测试过好几次了，一直没过。我看，这次也悬。”旁边传来大嗓门。
罗峰看过去，说话的是一名络腮胡子壮汉。杨武立即一瞪眼：“姓童的，你还说我，你不是也考核过两次也没过？我看，就你的神经反应速度，恐怕还要再苦练个两三年。”
“安静点。”一道冷喝声音从大堂中央传来。
顿时在场八人都转头看去，只见一名穿着宽松练功服的中年男子看了一眼，“走，都跟我上楼，马上接受准武者考核，。”
“是。”不管是之前嚣张的络腮胡子，还是杨武，亦或是罗峰，大家都恭敬应道。
“总教官的老朋友？”罗峰心中不由猜测起来。
须知，扬州城内有一所极限会馆和12所极限武馆。各区的极限武馆馆主，被称之为‘教官’。而总部极限会馆的馆主，则是被称之为‘总教官’。
进入电梯后，那穿着宽松运动服中年男子按了‘6’。
“滴！”电梯来到六楼。
电梯门中就有罗峰认识的教官‘江年’。
“人来了，别聊了。”一名披散着长发的中年人开口道，练武厅中十几人都转头看向罗峰等八人。面对这十几人的注视，罗峰等八人都感到心中一紧，他们知道……平常出现在极限会馆内的，除了服务人员外，就是武者了。
也就是说，这十几人都是武者！毕竟这是极限武馆在整个扬州城的大本营。
“准备测试。”这披散长发的中年人吩咐道。
罗峰在网络上看过这披散长发中年人，这人正是极限会馆的馆主，扬州城内的总教官‘邬通’。
“一个个过来，先将身份证给我。”之前领罗峰八人上来的武者，从罗峰他们八人手里接过了身份证，直接送到了总教官‘邬通’手里，笑道，“头，今天人还不少。有八个！”
“嗯。”邬通随意取出一张身份证，在旁边

仪器上弹出一晶莹的好似透明的屏幕，屏幕上浮现出了个人大量信息。
“第一个，童关。”总教官淡漠道，“进行拳力测试。你们军队出身的人，也跑到我极限武馆来考核，有趣。”
在旁边的罗峰一听，不由露出一丝笑容，极限武馆乃是世界第一强者创立，各个武馆遍布全球。极限武馆的考核是具有公信力的，含金量高。考核成绩拿出去，在全世界各国各个地区，都是得到承认的。
就连军队的，或者一些家族性传承修炼的，都喜欢来极限武馆进行考核。
“测试拳力。”总教官吩咐道。
“是。”
络腮胡子大汉立即上前一步，随即双眸暴睁，左手挡在脸前，右拳划过一道弧线便砸在那巨型的拳靶之上，拳靶只是微微颤了颤。拳力测试机的屏幕上立即浮现了数字――‘986kg’。
“过，下一个，罗峰。”总教官随意将第二个身份证在仪器上滑过，看了看身份详细记录信息，不由惊讶道，“咦，十八周岁？老江，这是你宜安区的吧，啥时候冒出这么个有天赋的小伙子了。”
“哈哈。”旁边的教官‘江年’不由畅快得意一笑。
“有没实力，还难说呢。”旁边十几名武者中，其中一个很是肥胖的老者揶揄笑道，“说不定是来见见世面的，没什么实力。”
教官江年瞥了一眼：“怎么，嫉妒了？你们北邮区那边没这样的天才吧。罗峰，给他们瞧瞧我宜安区学员的实力。”
“是，教官。”罗峰上前一步响亮应道，而后朝拳力测试机走去
content_en:
"Mom and Dad, I went to the 'Extreme Club' in the center of the city. I may not come for lunch today." Luo Feng drank a large bowl of porridge and three noodles and stood up. "You just wait for my good news today. I will call you as soon as I pass the exam."
Mother Gong Xinlan smiled and glanced at Luo Hongguo: "Hongguo, did you hear that? You have to carry your mobile phone with you. Don't let your son find you by then."
"I will definitely bring my mobile phone." Luo Hongguo chuckled.
"Well, I'm out."
Luo Feng winked at his younger brother Luo Hua, who gave him a thumbs up and smiled.
××××××
Early in the morning, Luo Feng left Nan'an Community, followed Metro Line 11 to Zhong'an Road Station, and then transferred to Line 1 and arrived at the central area of Yangzhou City. After exiting the subway station, he walked for another ten minutes before arriving at the Extreme Martial Arts Headquarters in Yangzhou City, the Ultimate Guild Hall.
It was only after six o'clock when I left home. By the time Luo Feng arrived at his destination, it was already nearly eight o'clock in the morning.
"Is this the legendary Mingyue Community?" Luo Feng stood outside the gate of a quiet community. This community is called 'Mingyue Community', and the Extreme Guild Hall is located in this community.
"Sir, this is Mingyue Community, don't get close."
I saw a row of six soldiers wearing military uniforms with live ammunition standing at the gate of the community. You can tell by looking at their military uniforms... These people are not from the police system, but from the military system. One of the soldiers shouted to Luo Feng: "Sir, please step back. Once you enter the yellow line area, we have the right to shoot you to death directly!"
"It's just like the rumors." Luo Feng sighed inwardly.
Mingyue Community is the base camp of Extreme Martial Arts School in Yangzhou City!
Here, not only is there the Extreme Martial Arts Hall, but it is also the residence of the martial arts families under the Extreme Martial Arts Hall.
"It is rumored that the people living here are warriors and their families! Even the police are not qualified to break in." Luo Feng was amazed in his heart.
"Everyone." Luo Feng stood at the gate of the community and said, "I am 'Luo Feng', a senior student of the Extreme Martial Arts Hall. I came here this time to accept the quasi-martial arts assessment." On the 1st of every month, the Extreme Martial Arts Hall will hold the quasi-martial arts assessment.
"Oh?"
An old man with gray hair walked out of the guard lounge next to the community. He was holding a palmtop computer in his hand. "Young man, you came very early. You arrived before eight o'clock. You are taking the quasi-martial artist examination at a young age, and you have a bright future. Well, let me check your ID card and senior student ID card."
Luo Feng handed over his ID card and student ID card.
"Toot!"
The ID card and senior student ID card were swiped across the handheld computer respectively, and messages appeared on the screen of the handheld computer one after another.
"18 years old?" The gray-haired old man glanced at Luo Feng in surprise and said with a smile, "If you are 18 years old, you dare to take the quasi-martial artist assessment. Not bad. I hope you can pass today."
"Thank you, old sir." Luo Feng also said.
"Let him in." The gray-haired old man waved his hand.
Immediately, the electric sliding door of the community opened automatically, and at the same time, a soldier holding an assault rifle stepped forward and followed Luo Feng: "Sir, I will take you to the Extreme Club. Please don't run around after entering the community! You only have permission to enter the Extreme Club and are not allowed to enter the accommodation area for warrior families. If you violate the regulations, even if I don't take action, the brothers patrolling in the community will." The soldier said and grinned at Luo Feng.
"Definitely." Luo Feng smiled and nodded, feeling secretly shocked...
The country and extreme martial arts schools are indeed in a cooperative relationship. At least the core area of ​​the Extreme Martial Arts School is under key protection.
"Phew, there are all single-family villas in each building." Luo Feng glanced over, except for the extreme guild hall standing tall in the center of the community. In other places, there are single-family villas scattered in a scattered manner, and between the villas, there areThere are rockeries, pools and grasslands.
××××××
In the Mingyue Community Center, inside the Extreme Club Hall, when Luo Feng walked into the lobby of the Extreme Club Hall, the soldier also went back.
"Sir, are you taking the quasi-martialist assessment?" In the lobby of the guild hall, a sweet-looking girl smiled and said, "Sir, please sit over there. Wait until ten o'clock in the morning, and then take the quasi-martialist assessment together with the others."
Luo Feng nodded and walked towards the lobby of the club, which was a small bar with a waiter and a bartender.
"Huh?" Luo Feng glanced at it and saw that there were already three people sitting in the small bar.
Two of them were talking, while the other one was sitting silently on another sofa.
"Look, the villas over there are the benefits of joining the extreme martial arts gym." A young man in white clothes and white pants said excitedly, "As long as you become a warrior and join the extreme martial arts gym, you will be assigned to one for free. And you can live here in the future... Tsk tsk, look at this environment, how comfortable it is."
"The warrior community is of course different from the ordinary communities outside. Look, there are newcomers." The three people also saw Luo Feng, who nodded slightly to the three people and sat on the sofa nearby.
No one knew each other, so there was no conversation.
As time passed, three more people came one after another. Luo Feng also didn't recognize these three people, but it seemed... these three people were all older, probably over thirty years old, and some were even over forty years old.
"Ha, Luo Feng!" a loud voice sounded.
Luo Feng was startled and turned around to look, only to see a lean man with a hideous scar on his face walking over: "Are you also here for the quasi-warrior assessment?"
"Brother Yang?" Luo Feng stood up and came over.
"It's embarrassing to say that, last month, I came to test once. Unfortunately - my speed test only reached 24.9 meters per second. It's just a little bit short, I failed!" Yang Wu said helplessly. In fact, in terms of punching power and nerve reaction speed, Yang Wu has already passed the test, but speed is his weakness.
However, since this year, Yang Wu has gradually improved in speed. In fact, there is not much difference between 24.9 meters and 25 meters. If the temporary condition is better, the result may be 25 meters.
"I believe you will be able to pass the test this time, Brother Yang." Luo Feng said with a smile.
"This guy surnamed Yang has been tested several times and has never passed. I think he failed this time too." A loud voice came from the side.
Luo Feng looked over and saw that the person speaking was a strong man with a beard. Yang Wu immediately glared: "Tong, you are still talking about me. Didn't you pass the test twice and failed? I think, based on your nerve reaction speed, I am afraid you will have to practice hard for another two or three years."
"Be quiet." A cold voice came from the center of the lobby.
Immediately, the eight people present turned their heads and saw a middle-aged man wearing loose training clothes. He glanced at him and said, "Come on, follow me upstairs. You will be tested as a prospective martial artist immediately."
"Yes." Whether it was the arrogant bearded man before, Yang Wu, or Luo Feng, everyone responded respectfully.
"The chief instructor's old friend?" Luo Feng couldn't help but guess.
It should be noted that there is one extreme guild hall and 12 extreme martial arts gyms in Yangzhou City. The heads of extreme martial arts gyms in each district are called ‘instructors’. The owner of the Extreme Club at the headquarters is called the ‘chief instructor’.
After entering the elevator, the middle-aged man in loose sportswear pressed '6'.
"Beep!" The elevator reached the sixth floor.
Inside the elevator door was the instructor 'Jiang Nian' whom Luo Feng knew.
"We're here, stop chatting." A middle-aged man with long hair said. More than a dozen people in the martial arts training hall turned to look at Luo Feng and the other eight people. Facing the gazes of these dozen people, Luo Feng and the other eight people felt their hearts tightening. They knew that... apart from the service staff, the people who usually appeared in the Extreme Club were warriors.
In other words, these dozen people are allWarrior! After all, this is the base camp of Extreme Martial Arts School in the entire Yangzhou City.
"Get ready for the test." The middle-aged man with long hair ordered.
Luo Feng had seen this middle-aged man with long hair on the Internet. This man was the owner of the Extreme Guild Hall and the chief instructor in Yangzhou City, ‘Wu Tong’.
"Come over one by one and give me your ID cards first." The warrior who led Luo Feng and the eight of them up took the ID cards from Luo Feng and the others and sent them directly to the chief instructor 'Wu Tong'. He said with a smile, "Boss, there are quite a lot of people today. There are eight of them!"
"Yeah." Wu Tong casually took out an ID card and placed it next to
A crystal-like transparent screen popped up on the instrument, and a large amount of personal information appeared on the screen.
"The first one, Tong Guan." The chief instructor said indifferently, "Let's conduct a boxing test. People from your military background also come to my extreme martial arts gym to take the test. It's interesting."
Luo Feng, who was standing next to him, couldn't help but smile when he heard this. The Ultimate Martial Arts School was founded by the world's strongest man, and there are various martial arts schools all over the world. The assessment of Extreme Martial Arts School is credible and contains high gold content. The assessment results are recognized in all countries and regions around the world.
Even those in the military, or those who practice through family inheritance, like to come to the Extreme Martial Arts Hall for assessments.
"Test your fist strength." the chief instructor ordered.
"Yes."
The bearded man immediately took a step forward, his eyes widened immediately, his left hand was in front of his face, his right fist drew an arc and hit the giant boxing target, which only trembled slightly. The number immediately appeared on the screen of the boxing strength testing machine - '986kg'.
"Come on, next, Luo Feng." The chief instructor casually slid the second ID card over the instrument, looked at the detailed identity record information, and couldn't help but said in surprise, "Hey, eighteen years old? Lao Jiang, this is from your Yi'an District. When did such a talented young man appear?"
"Haha." The instructor next to him, 'Jiang Nian', couldn't help but smile happily.
"Whether he has strength or not, it's hard to say." One of the dozen warriors nearby, a very fat old man, said with a smile, "Maybe he is here to see the world, but he doesn't have much strength."
Instructor Jiang Nian glanced at him and said, "Why, are you jealous? You don't have such geniuses in the North Postal District. Luo Feng, let them see the strength of my students from Yi'an District."
"Yes, instructor." Luo Feng took a step forward and responded loudly, then walked towards the boxing strength testing machine.
